prompt.name: Observation Balloon (First World War)
prompt.look: A tethered First World War observation balloon: a large oval gas envelope with a few tan seams and a small tail fin at the back, a rope net holding a wicker gondola basket below it, an observer in a leather cap leaning out of the basket with binoculars, and a short tether rope hanging down from the basket.
prompt.gear: The envelope hangs level above the basket, the rope net and tether hang straight down, and nothing touches the edges of the image.
prompt.identity: the same oval envelope, tail fin, rope net, wicker basket, observer, binoculars and tether, and the same red envelope
prompt.damage_gear: a patched seam and a sagging rope
prompt.damage_gear_critical: a torn envelope, a frayed net and a split basket

states.note: a gentle sway and bob built in code from the master and from each damage drawing; no propeller
the balloon is not a weapon: its attack row is a plain jolt (the hit rig), never a muzzle flash
the envelope jolted and swinging, built in code
